analysis:
Both units are head-side excerpts of CHANGELOG.md (lines 466-664 and 665-858). No patch hunks or base text were supplied, so I could not tell which lines this PR added or changed. The file is documentation only, and I saw no code, config, workflow, or authorization change in these units.

The most likely new lines are the top entries at 466-477. They cover MiMo fused decode kernels on by default with documented 0/false/no/off rollbacks, no serial-target MTP draft rounds, CI changes (SSD caching enabled for the exact-cache E2E checkpoint, Homebrew setup via a pinned checksum-verified script), and a coordinator metrics-attribution lock change. None of these touch the coordinator-provider trust boundary, attestation, key custody, or billing. Entries already in earlier release sections that touch security-relevant behavior and need checking if their source was part of this PR: default-on MiMo text COMPLETE-prefix SSD caching (471, 485-487), SSD write budget raised from 150 to 750 GB/day (576), 30-minute TTL (661), cached-token billing (609-615), and removal of the unauthenticated earnings endpoint (636).

T-041 already covers default-on encrypted SSD caching, per-account cacheSalt scoping, the 30-minute TTL and per-donation endurance guards. I found no changelog statement that contradicts it. The changelog does not state the 750 GB/day budget in T-041, but T-041 defers to endurance guards generally, so this is not a material gap.

Coverage limit: because no diff or source was provided, I cannot verify that the changelog matches the actual code. A later pass should examine the source files behind these claims (SSDPrefixCachePolicy, the MiMo default gates, and the launchd environment-variable forwarding) if they appear in the PR.
